get_config_nh3: get the FermiNet configuration for running an ammonia (NH3) molecule simulation
run_nh3_simulation: run a FermiNet quantum chemistry simulation on the ammonia molecule using the default config
review_nh3_config: review the ammonia molecule geometry and electron configuration in the FermiNet config
summarize_get_config: summarize the get_config function that returns an NH3 ConfigDict with molecular geometry and electron counts
modify_nh3_geometry: modify the ammonia molecule atomic coordinates or electron count in the FermiNet configuration
